name: Contribution Score
summary: Scores Deep Funding Portal users based on the comments they write.
description:
### What it does
Scores the quality and impact of each user's comments in the Deep Funding Portal.

### How it works
- Each user is identified by their DID.
- Every valid comment starts with a base score.
- Upvotes add points, while downvotes remove points.
- Comments on your own proposal and replies to yourself can receive a penalty.
- An upvote from the proposal owner can add a bonus.
- Older comments can lose value over time.

### Data source
Uses proposal, comment, user, and vote data from the Deep Funding Portal.

### Outputs
- CSV file with `did` and `contribution_score`.
- JSON file with score details for each user and comment.

inputs.label: Base score per comment
inputs.description: Points a valid comment receives before votes, bonuses, penalties, and decay.

inputs.label: Upvote weight
inputs.description: How much one upvote increases the comment score.

inputs.label: Downvote weight
inputs.description: How much one downvote reduces the comment score.

inputs.label: Self-interaction penalty
inputs.description: Multiplier for comments on your own proposal and replies to yourself. Use `1` to turn off this penalty.

inputs.label: Proposal owner upvote bonus
inputs.description: Multiplier used when the proposal owner upvotes a comment. Use `1` to turn off this bonus.

inputs.label: Lookback period (months)
inputs.description: Only comments from this number of past months are included.

inputs.label: Monthly decay (%)
inputs.description: Percentage removed from a comment's score for each month of age. Use `0` to turn off decay.

outputs.label: Contribution score (CSV)
outputs.description: One row per user with their final contribution score.

columns.description: Raw user score. It is not normalized, so its range depends on the included comments.

outputs.label: Contribution score details (JSON)
outputs.description: Score details for each user and comment.
